portBusy: The screen's port {port} is open in another program (usually ZEUS CAST). Close it so Hydraflow can use the screen.
portGone: Port {port} disappeared (cable unplugged or the cooler restarted).
hidBusy: Windows couldn't open the screen over HID (another program, such as ZEUS CAST, may be using it): {error}
noAnswer: The screen didn't answer the "{command}" command ({port}). Turn the PC off and on if it keeps happening.
badReply: Invalid reply from the screen to the "{command}" command: {error}.
reply.checksum: reply checksum or length doesn't match
